start.text: Report sent. We know what Victor did. We do not know why. And a real sign-in cannot be told from a wrong one by looking at the password.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Joshua, I read your report. Not every odd access is bad. HR is allowed in the salary folder. IT works at night when on call.
A.name: Carla

B.text: So tonight we watch who opens what. Each job has its own folders, and the hours matter too.
B.name: Carla

C1.text: The [b][color=green]rulebook[/color][/b] has a table: each role and its folders. If the folder does not match the job, that is the sign.
C1.name: Carla

C2.text: No. Real work happens at odd hours too. We look at the job and the hour together.
C2.name: Carla

D.text: [b][color=red]Report[/color][/b] access that does not fit the job. Let the rest [b][color=green]pass[/color][/b].
D.name: Carla

E.text: One folder at a time. A real person with a real badge can still be in the wrong place.
E.name: Joshua
